Experience the Affordable Lifestyle of California’s Capital

Sacramento isn’t just California’s capital; it’s also way more affordable than pricey places like San Francisco or LA. Here, you can get more houses for your money. As more people look for places that offer space without breaking the bank, Sacramento is becoming increasingly popular.

How to Get Great Property Deals in Sacramento County?

Every year, Sacramento County offers opportunities to investors by auctioning properties that have defaulted on their taxes. These tax sales are a way for the county to recoup lost revenue, ensuring essential services continue. For investors, it’s a chance to buy properties at discounted rates.

Sacramento County Annual Tax Sale Schedule

The main tax sale in Sacramento takes place on the last Monday of February each year. If the auction doesn’t sell or postpones properties, they hold another sale on the second Monday of May or sometime in June.

  • February Sale: Property lists are released in November or early December.
  • May/June Sale: Property lists are unveiled in April.

To access these lists, visit the Sacramento County website.

Steps to Bid on Sacramento Tax Sales

  1. Deposit: Be ready with a deposit of $5,000 and a non-refundable $35 processing fee. They return your deposit within 10 business days if you don’t win a property.
  2. Research: Always research properties before placing your bid. Remember, they sell all properties “AS IS,” so doing your pre-auction research is crucial.
  3. Online Auction: Sacramento County uses Bid4Assets for their online auctions.

Tips for Successful Bidding

  • Understand the Process: Use the free resources provided by Sacramento County and familiarize yourself with the auction process.

FAQs

What is a Tax Deed Sale?

A tax deed sale is a public auction where properties with unpaid taxes are sold to the highest bidder. The buyer receives full ownership of the property.

How can I find properties for the tax sale?

Property lists are published on the Sacramento County website. Check-in in November or early December for the February sale and April for the May/June sale.

What do I need to participate in the auction?

You’ll need a $5,000 deposit and a $35 processing fee to register for the auction. Make sure to research the properties ahead of time since they sell everything “AS IS.”

Can I inspect the properties before the auction?

Most properties are sold without prior inspection. It’s important to do as much research as possible using public records and any available resources.

How is the bidding process conducted?

Sacramento County conducts its tax deed auctions online through Bid4Assets. You can place bids from anywhere with internet access.
